summary: Western Midstream Operating, LP filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of the acquisition of Brazos Delaware II, LLC by its parent WES through a wholly owned subsidiary. The aggregate purchase price was ~$1.6B, split equally between ~$800M cash and 19,389,239 WES common units valued at ~$800M based on a 20-day VWAP at signing. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing notes the acquisition closed on June 11, 2026, with Brazos Delaware becoming an indirect wholly owned subsidiary. Watch for integration updates and any post-closing adjustments.
